step1_analysis.circuit_type: Spatial Contrast and Orientation Extraction Sub-circuit
step1_analysis.description: This circuit computes local spatial features for a vision sensor pixel. It samples neighboring pixel voltages (VL, VR, VT, VB) via NMOS switches and uses them to modulate PMOS transistors, which inject current into a common summing node (IF) to compute spatial averages or contrast components.

paper_reference.title: A 128 128 Pixel 120-dB Dynamic-Range Vision-Sensor Chip for Image Contrast and Orientation Extraction

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 8 PMOS transistors (W/L=5/0.5) in saturation at Vsg=0.9V, I_pmos ≈ 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 ≈ 57uA each. Total current ≈ 450uA. Power = 450uA * 1.8V = 810uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Higher than the paper's reported value because the paper likely biased the pixel in subthreshold or weak inversion to save power, whereas this estimate assumes strong inversion mid-rail inputs.

dynamic_range.description: The output voltage swing at the IF node across the full input voltage range.

sky130_expected.calculation: IF is clamped by diode-connected NMOS to ground. Max voltage is when all PMOS are fully ON (V_IF ≈ 1.2V), min is when all are OFF (V_IF ≈ 0V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 120 dB in the paper refers to optical illumination range (handled by a log photoreceptor). The electrical voltage swing at IF is limited by the VDD and Vth of the diode-connected NMOS.

contrast_gain.description: The sensitivity of the output IF voltage to changes in the input pixel voltage (dV_IF / dV_VL).

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm_pmos / gm_nmos_diode. Total PMOS W=40u, NMOS W=10u. Gain ≈ sqrt((40*50)/(10*270)) ≈ 0.86 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The gain is determined by the ratio of the transconductances of the input PMOS and the load NMOS diodes.

sample_time.description: Time required for the internal sample node (N1) to settle to the input voltage (VL) when SMP goes high.

sky130_expected.calculation: R_on of NMOS switch (W/L=5/0.5) at Vgs=1.8V is ~1kΩ. C_gate of PMOS (W/L=5/0.5) is ~5fF. Tau = 1k * 5fF = 5ps. Settling time (5*tau) ≈ 25ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Extremely fast due to the small parasitic capacitance of the internal nodes and the relatively wide NMOS switches.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, contrast gain, output dynamic range, and transient sampling time.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Vision Sensor Contrast Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 COSN N1 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 COSN N2 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 COSP N1 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 COSP N2 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 SINN N4 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 SINN N3 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 SINP N4 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 SINP N3 IF VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 SMP VL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N2 SMP VR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 SMP VT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N4 SMP VB VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 IF IF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 IF IF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VCOSN COSN 0 1.8
VCOSP COSP 0 1.8
VSINN SINN 0 1.8
VSINP SINP 0 1.8

VSMP SMP 0 dc 1.8 pulse(0 1.8 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
VVL VL 0 dc 0.9 pwl(0 0.9 5n 1.2)
VVR VR 0 0.9
VVT VT 0 0.9
VVB VB 0 0.9

.ic v(N1)=0 v(N2)=0 v(N3)=0 v(N4)=0

.control
* DC Sweep for Gain, Dynamic Range, and Power
dc VVL 0 1.8 0.01
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas dc pwr_avg avg power
let gain = deriv(v(IF))
meas dc max_gain_mag min gain
meas dc v_if_max max v(IF)
meas dc v_if_min min v(IF)
let dr_linear = v_if_max - v_if_min
print pwr_avg max_gain_mag dr_linear

* Transient for Sample Time
tran 0.1n 30n
meas tran t_sample trig v(SMP) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.15 rise=1
print t_sample
quit
.endc
